current.text: Dejounte Murray is back with New Orleans and will have the ball in his hands. The Pelicans also have second-year guard Jeremiah Fears, added Bennedict Mathurin and have a new coach, Jamahl Mosley.
Murphy is locked into the starting lineup with Murray and Zion Williamson.
The Pelicans have a crowded rotation with more players than minutes. Murphy is basically the only floor spacer on a team that lacks shooting.

Experts disagree on his role. Several expect less usage and possibly fewer minutes, because his big role last season came while Murray, Herb Jones and Jordan Poole were out. Lloyd does not believe his role is unstable.

Experts disagree on his category price. Lloyd would take him around pick 20, and another expert calls pick 28 justifiable in categories. One expert calls rank 30 too high, and others call 9-cat rankings that put him in the top 20 absurd.
In auctions, Josh values him in the mid 20s USD and calls 21 USD good value. Josh also thinks he has slid too far in drafts.
His ESPN rank in the mid 40s and ESPN ADP of 77 are too low.
His team-friendly contract puts his trade value at its peak. The Pelicans reportedly want about three first-round picks and a young player for him.
New Orleans projects as a weak team at the bottom of the West, at about 34 wins. Experts do not expect the team to tank.

durable.text: He is worth clearly more in category leagues than in points leagues. Experts would not take him in the top 50 in points formats, so points rankings underrate him for us.
His best categories are threes, FT% on good volume, points and steals. He has no weak category, so he fits any build.

note: He fits every build. His threes, FT%, points and steals all help, and he has no weak category. The points-league complaints do not apply to us. Market prices run from 9.2 USD (ESPN average cost) to 30 USD (Yahoo value). He went for 20 USD in our league last season, and Josh's mid-20s USD range (21 USD as good value) looks like a fair target. Early in the season, check how his shot volume holds up with Dejounte Murray running the offense, and whether trade talk around his contract heats up.
